about: Shared cases for turning a §8 instance name into a room card's label (sanitizeLabel / sanitizeAdvertLabel), run by both apps' unit tests (NearbyLabelTest.kt, NearbyLabelTests.swift). The name is display-declared: its whitespace is collapsed, the display suffix dropped, and the rest cut to 24 UTF-16 units on a whole code point.

cases.label: Living Room (2)
cases.note: longer than the cap on the wire: the suffix goes before the cut, and a clash rename stays

cases.label: Living Room
cases.note: no suffix (tvOS, older displays): only the whitespace is normalised

cases.label: Paper Balloon · Paper Ba
cases.note: only a trailing suffix is the marker

cases.label: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV🎈
cases.note: an emoji is two units: this one just fits

cases.label: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
cases.note: and this one doesn't: it goes whole, never as half a surrogate pair
